title: Monomial under frequency reindexing
statement: Let $J$ be a finite set of coordinates among $n$, let $S$ be a subset of $J$, and let $y$ be a sign assignment to the $|J|$ positions. Reindex the elements of $S$ by their positions in the enumeration of $J$, and transfer $y$ to an assignment on $J$ using that enumeration. The monomial on the reindexed set evaluated at $y$ equals the monomial on $S$ evaluated at the transferred assignment.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates among $n$
$y$ is a sign assignment on $|J|$ positions
